description: Takes net monthly income, existing EMIs, annual rate and tenure and returns the maximum EMI and home loan amount a borrower qualifies for. Example input: {"netMonthlyIncome":150000,"existingEmis":10000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, for example 8.5

existingEmis.description: Total EMIs already paid each month in rupees (default 0)

foir.description: Share of income a bank lets all EMIs take, 0.1 to 1 (default 0.5)

months.description: Loan tenure in months (6 to 480). Give months or years.

netMonthlyIncome.description: Net monthly take-home income in rupees

years.description: Loan tenure in years (0.5 to 40). Give months or years.

name: eligibility
